component.name: CallDucker
component.summary: Adjust game audio automatically during calls

description.p: CallDucker listens for voice-call streams and sets matching games to a chosen target volume. It restores every original channel volume when the last call ends.
Discord calls and games launched by Steam, Heroic or Lutris are detected automatically.
Fixes a restore journal entry that could report the audio service as unavailable, and a startup race that could make the window show a D-Bus error.
First release with packages for Fedora, Debian, Ubuntu, and Arch Linux.
